questions.question: Describe a translation, a reflection and a rotation, and state what stays the same in all three.
questions.expected_answer: Translation: every point slides the same distance in the same direction. Reflection: every point is flipped to the same distance on the other side of a mirror line. Rotation: every point turns about a centre through an angle in a direction. Shape and size stay the same: the image is congruent.

questions.question: How can you tell from the image whether a figure was translated or reflected?
questions.expected_answer: A translated image faces the same way; a reflected image is reversed (a right-pointing flag points left after a vertical mirror).

questions.question: A flagpole pointing up is rotated 90° clockwise about its base. Which way does it point? Which anticlockwise turn gives the same result?
questions.expected_answer: It points right. A 270° anticlockwise turn gives the same image.
